metadata.prompt: Produce a single image laid out as a 2x2 grid of four equally sized cells. Cells must share their edges directly and fill the whole canvas edge to edge: no gutters, no separator lines, no padding, no outer margin or border around the grid. The four cells depict four consecutive narrative story beats evolving from the supplied image, read left to right, top to bottom. Each beat advances the action, character pose and emotional progression with physical cause and effect. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Keep environment, character identity, lighting and color grading consistent across all four cells while clearly showing the progression between moments. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：16:9（已写入输出节点 size）

  ratio: "16:9",

    "The four cells depict four consecutive narrative story beats evolving from the supplied image, read left to right, top to bottom. Each beat advances the action, character pose and emotional progression with physical cause and effect.",

    "Keep environment, character identity, lighting and color grading consistent across all four cells while clearly showing the progression between moments.",
    Xa

}
